snippet.title: Sails of Salt – Gameplay Trailer | Pirate Roguelite · Free Demo
snippet.description:
Wishlist and play the free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5084680/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=trailer
Discord – bugs, ideas, voyages: https://discord.gg/NwUY7yRnDR

Sail out. Get greedy. Make it home – or die a legend.

Sails of Salt is a singleplayer pirate roguelite: Black Flag's ship battles as an FTL-style roguelite. Helm your own ship through real-time broadside battles, keep your crew alive, and sail further out for richer prizes while the Empire hunts you. Bring the loot home – or your captain dies for good, and the next one inherits the legend.

The free demo is on Steam now – and in Steam Next Fest, October 19–26.

• Real-time broadsides: aim and fire your guns yourself, then board what you can't sink.
• Push your luck: every league further out pays better and draws more of the Empire's attention.
• Permadeath with a legacy: captains die for good. Your harbour and your legend don't.
• A crew you can see: every sailor has a face, a role and a place on deck.
• A new sea every voyage: storms, forts, convoys, wrecks to salvage and harbours to trade in.
• Your own fleet: take prizes, sail them alongside you and fit out every hull at your yard.

Release: Q1 2027 · PC (Windows) · English, German, French, Italian, Spanish
Made by Barnacle Bytes, a solo developer from Germany.
Press & business: info@sailsofsalt.com
